title: Requirements
prompt: SAMPLE: A teammate wants to add a dark-mode preference to the URL shortener design interview. Accept or reject for this hour?

choices.label: Accept — ship dark mode in the design
choices.consequence: You spend the hour on UI chrome that does not change storage, traffic, or failure modes.

choices.label: Reject — it does not change storage, traffic, or failure
choices.consequence: You keep the hour for bounds and the first bottleneck, which the frame actually grades.

choices.label: Defer by picking a database product first
choices.consequence: Naming a vendor early hides whether the requirement mattered to the design.

choices.label: Expand into a full theming system
choices.consequence: Scope explodes without touching the interview's force diagram.
